title: The phone number
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Tuesday. Deadlines have phone numbers. Wood dials it from the frame shop's phone. It rings twice. He hangs up. The strip draws the receiver going down as the biggest thing in the panel.

panels.composition: The frame shop. The wall phone. WOOD with the receiver and the scholarship letter — creased, from a pocket. Dialing. The OWNER not watching, watching.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man at a frame shop's wall phone dialing a number from a creased letter while an older woman pretends not to watch

panels.composition: The receiver at his ear. A ring drawn as a jagged line. Two of them.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, close-up of a young man with a phone receiver at his ear and two jagged ring shapes

panels.composition: The receiver going down onto the hook. Drawn huge — the panel is the receiver.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, an extreme close-up of a hand setting a phone receiver down on its hook, the receiver filling the whole panel
image.notes: The receiver fills the panel. The arc's loudest silent image.

panels.composition: Wood back at the foam core. The Owner. The letter on the counter between them, face up. Neither touches it.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man cutting foam core and an older woman at her station with a letter lying face up on the counter between them

notes: Two rings. The receiver as the panel. 'Mm.'
